newsitem.title: INDIA: Lucent seeks stake in India Tata Telecom.
newsitem.headline: Lucent seeks stake in India Tata Telecom.

text.p: India's Tata Telecom will offer a 25 percent equity stake at a premium of 50 rupees per share to Lucent Technologies, a senior official of the Indian company said on Tuesday.
"We will seek shareholders' consent for the preferential offer at a meeting on April 25," a senior official of Tata Telecom who did not wish to be named told Reuters by telephone from New Delhi.
The Indian company will offer 3.6 million shares to US's Lucent, representing a 25 percent stake in Tata Telecom, the official said.

Tata Telecom already has a joint venture with Lucent Technologies for manufacture of transmission equipment, the official of the Indian firm added. Tata Telecom belongs to the Tata group, India's largest business houses.
Shares of Tata Telecom ended four rupees, or nearly ten percent, higher at a provisional 45.25 rupees at the Bombay Stock Exchange on Tuesday.
